05505.relevant_patterns_trends_and_comparisons:
Qualitative conversion loads are represented with absolute internal consistency.

    The cumulative line curves smoothly from the lowest to the highest limits.

    The distribution relies entirely on these strict proportional boundaries.
05505.essential_key_details:
Lowest tier loads correspond to the designated minimum floor.

    Highest tier loads correspond to the maximum ceiling.

    The dataset average is drawn evenly from the rigid figures.
